flags.text: -119% of 5-yr profit turned into operating cash
Working-capital cycle lengthened 350 days in 2 yrs (now 587)

business.whatItDoes: ideaForge Technology Ltd. designs, develops, engineers, and manufactures unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and drone platforms. The company provides complete hardware, software, and drone-as-a-service solutions for defense, homeland security, and civil enterprise applications.

segments.name: Defense and Homeland Security
segments.comment: Core revenue driver for surveillance, reconnaissance, and tactical missions.

segments.name: Civil and Enterprise Applications
segments.comment: Includes geospatial mapping, infrastructure inspection, agriculture, and disaster response.

business.geography: Domestic focus with growing international presence, including a joint venture in the United States and global distribution networks.
scale: 300+ member R&D team across 4 product development centers
INR 3,140 million opening order book for FY 2026-27
risks: Technology obsolescence requiring sustained investments in autonomy and AI-enabled analytics.
Cybersecurity and data security risks including signal jamming, GPS spoofing, and cyber intrusion.
Supply chain vulnerabilities and dependence on imported electronics and sensors.
Regulatory changes affecting type certification, pilot licensing, and BVLOS permissions.

guidance.statement: Blended gross margin would likely hover between a 50%, 55% range for the year.
guidance.quote: our blended gross margin would likely hover between a 50%, 55% range for the year.
guidance.speaker: Vipul Joshi

guidance.statement: Complete delivery of the remaining order book of INR256.8 crores by Q3.
guidance.quote: we remain focused on completing delivery of the remaining order book of INR256.8 crores by Q3 as per customer timelines.
guidance.speaker: Ankit Mehta

growthCommentary: Delivered more than 20% of opening order book, recording revenue from operations of INR68.6 crores and closed the quarter with positive EBITDA.
Order execution supported by ongoing developmental programs across combat drones and YETI middle-mile logistics UAV.
Demand environment aided by announcements of INR20,000 crores drone procurements through Fast Track mode and expanded delegation of financial powers.
Product mix variance with higher defense EW resilience contribution impacted gross margins compared to previous periods.

pushback.question: While we have capabilities and funding, why are government orders slow, and where is the disconnect for the entire drone space?
pushback.answer: Large FTP opportunities follow specific approval cycles to RFP stages, while run-rate business from enhanced field commander powers typically fructifies in Q3 and Q4.

pushback.question: What is the scale-up in US operations, market size expectations, and progress on Blue sUAS certification?
pushback.answer: Focus is on operationalizing the JV and obtaining Blue sUAS certification, which is an open application process taking time before gaining substantial defense traction.

pushback.question: Are supply chain constraints impacting the execution of the order book by Q3?
pushback.answer: Geopolitical conflicts create pressure on thermal cameras and electronic supply chains with shifting timelines, but customer delivery commitments remain on track.

guidance.statement: Blended EBITDA margin expectation for the year is 50% to 55%
guidance.quote: My expectation as a blended for the year, roughly about 50% to 55% is our hope for the year.
guidance.speaker: Vipul Joshi

growthCommentary: Executed around 40% of the open order book of Q3 in Q4, recording highest ever quarterly revenue and profit after tax.
Order booking momentum converted into execution, including acceptance of delivered electronic warfare resilience capability with real-world testing.
Opening order book for FY27 stood at approximately INR310 crores.

pushback.question: What sort of pipeline we have and what sort of inflow we are expecting in FY27 and what percentage of your order book we are expecting to execute in FY27?
pushback.answer: The open order book of about INR310 crores is slated for execution in FY27 itself, primarily in the first three quarters.

pushback.question: What is the latest update on ammunition licenses if you're entering into this long-range target drones?
pushback.answer: We do not intend to take those licenses even today and are partnering with handlers of munitions traditionally for the government.

pushback.question: Which specific subsystems or components are most at risk based on the current geopolitical side?
pushback.answer: Thermal imagers remain a constrained challenge for everyone at this point in time because of multiple reasons.

guidance.statement: Deliver around 40% to 45% of the open order book in the present quarter and recognize revenue.
guidance.quote: However, our readiness makes us confident of delivering around 40% to 45% of the open order book in the present quarter and recognizing the revenue.
guidance.speaker: Ankit Mehta

guidance.statement: Confident in full year's gross margin trajectory of 50% plus for FY26.
guidance.quote: We are confident in the full year's gross margin trajectory of 50% plus for FY '26, supported by our order mix and execution of higher-value programs in Q4.
guidance.speaker: Ankit Mehta

growthCommentary: While Q3 was muted in terms of numbers, impending demand finally fructified into orders and reinvigorated focus on delivery.
Year-to-date order inflow added approximately INR440 crores to the order book, the highest quantum in a single year.
Order inflow in Q3 was broad-based with over INR102 crores through large opportunities and roughly INR115 crores through smaller orders.
Order book stood at approximately INR368 crores as of January.

pushback.question: How do private local partners act in state-level tenders, and who bears working capital and bank guarantees?
pushback.answer: Partners help in penetration and execution, sometimes acting as lead bidders, with payment terms largely within 30 days.

pushback.question: If an ideaForge drone has additional capabilities beyond base specs, must it still be the lowest bidder to win?
pushback.answer: Typically it is L1 only after technical evaluation, though defense capital procurement allows enhanced performance parameters for pricing advantages.

pushback.question: Will the business continue to have lumpiness, or is there more visibility compared to past years?
pushback.answer: Baseline activity and run rate business are growing and stepping up, though very large opportunities will continue to create some lumpiness when they arrive.

growthCommentary: Consolidated revenues for the current quarter stood at INR40.8 crores versus INR37.1 crores in quarter 2 FY25 and INR53.5 crores in H1 FY26.
Gross profit margin was 50% for the quarter and 52.8% for H1 FY26, aided by better-margin contracts and differentiated products.
EBITDA for the quarter was minus INR8 crores and PAT was minus INR19.6 crores.
Order book stood at approximately INR238 crores as of 28th October 2025.

pushback.question: Will gross margins improve further given the defense-skewed order book or remain in a similar range?
pushback.answer: Management assumes gross margins will stay on similar lines as the current quarter for the remaining half.

pushback.question: How do you view competitors offering 20 kg payload capacities and 6-8 hour flight times compared to your ZOLT platform?
pushback.answer: Management stated they operate in specific category segments addressing distinct utility needs and have not compared directly to those products, though they assess technical contexts.

pushback.question: Why did ideaForge stick only to mapping and surveillance and enter target/munition drones like ZOLT relatively late?
pushback.answer: Management explained they were bootstrapped initially, limited by capital, and prioritized balanced dual-use applications and predictable cycles over pure defense capabilities.

synthesis.take: ideaForge faces heavy revenue lumpiness and a severe working capital drag, with the cash conversion cycle stretching to 587 days. Despite high order book figures, persistent cash burn (-INR 63 crores CFO in FY26) exposes execution risks.

Blended gross margin would likely hover between 50%, 55% for the year

promises.delivered: Executed around 40% of open order book, recording INR141.04 crore revenue

promises.promise: Gross margin trajectory of 50% plus for FY26
promises.delivered: Full year FY26 revenue was INR226 crores with OPM at 2.6%

narrative.claim: Management stated that the open order book of about INR310 crores is slated for execution in FY27.
narrative.numbers: Revenue for Q1 FY27 was recorded at INR68.59 crores.

narrative.claim: Management highlights strong operational profitability and positive EBITDA at the close of FY26.
narrative.numbers: FY26 annual PAT was negative at -INR17 crores with negative operating cash flow of -INR63 crores.

bull.point: Opening order book stands strong at INR 3,140 million for FY 2026-27, supporting medium-term revenue visibility.
Demonstrated capability to scale execution sharply during favorable quarters, hitting INR 141.04 crores in Q4 FY26.
Extensive R&D footprint with over 300 members across four product development centers supporting technological moats.

bear.point: Working capital conditions have deteriorated significantly, with the cash conversion cycle stretching out to 587 days.
Continuous cash burn with negative operating cash flows of -INR 63 crores in FY26 against a net loss of -INR 17 crores.
High revenue lumpiness across quarters, driven by dependent government procurement cycles and defense ordering schedules.

watch: Execution progress against the remaining order book by Q3 FY27
Debtor days and cash conversion cycle improvements
Realization of guided 50-55% gross and EBITDA margins
